moments.title: Customer who disputes an eBill amount takes it up with the biller…
moments.customer_action: Customer who disputes an eBill amount takes it up with the biller directly; to stop the AutoPay payment, the customer edits or cancels the scheduled payment before it processes (free). Once processing has begun, only a stop-payment request is possible.

touchpoints.screen: Bill Pay > scheduled payment > edit/cancel; biller contact (outside TD); stop payment request (phone/written)

moments.frontstage: Online Banking Service Agreement (form 800356 (0124)) sec. 8(l): 'Neither the Bank nor its Bill Payment Service Provider is responsible for the accuracy of your electronic bill(s)'; discrepancies 'must be addressed with the Biller directly'; 'it is your sole responsibility to contact your Billers directly if you do not receive your statements'. Sec. 8(h)-(i): 'There is no charge for canceling or editing a Scheduled Payment prior to processing'; after processing begins 'the payment cannot be edited and a stop payment request must be submitted'; TD 'may also require you to present your request in writing within fourteen (14) days.' No in-app dispute flow or AutoPay hold for a disputed eBill.

exceptions.trigger: Customer disputes the amount on an eBill before AutoPay runs
exceptions.customer_experience: No dispute control in Bill Pay; customer must contact the biller and edit/cancel the scheduled AutoPay payment before it processes.
exceptions.bank_handling: Bank and Bill Payment Service Provider disclaim eBill accuracy; discrepancies 'must be addressed with the Biller directly'.
exceptions.resolution: Edit/cancel free before processing; stop payment after processing begins (written confirmation may be required within 14 days).

assessment: AutoPay exists but editing is cancel-and-recreate.
